title.zh: 精讲 · RUDY 拥塞估计

lines.zh: 这一讲用几分钟讲清 RUDY：布线之前，怎样估计哪里会挤。
lines.en: In a few minutes: RUDY, a way to estimate where wires will crowd before routing.
lines.speak_zh: 这一讲用几分钟，讲清鲁迪：布线之前，怎样估计哪里会挤。
lines.speak_en: In a few minutes: Rudy, a way to estimate where wires will crowd, before routing.

lines.zh: RUDY 是“矩形均匀布线密度”的英文缩写。
lines.en: RUDY stands for Rectangular Uniform wire DensitY.
lines.speak_zh: 鲁迪，是矩形均匀布线密度的英文缩写。
lines.speak_en: Rudy stands for rectangular uniform wire density.

lines.zh: 老师的例子：12 × 8 的芯片，六个引脚，六个线网。
lines.en: The teacher's example: a 12 by 8 chip, six pins, six nets.
lines.speak_zh: 老师的例子：12 乘 8 的芯片，六个引脚，六个线网。

lines.zh: 六个线网的 HPWL 加起来是 34。
lines.en: The six nets' HPWL adds up to 34.
lines.speak_zh: 六个线网的半周长线长，加起来是 34。
lines.speak_en: The six nets' H P W L adds up to thirty-four.

lines.zh: 可这个总数说不出：线会挤在哪里。
lines.en: But a total cannot say where the wires will crowd.

lines.zh: 所以把芯片切成 4 × 2 个布线格，每格宽 3、高 4。
lines.en: So cut the chip into 4 by 2 routing tiles, each 3 wide and 4 tall.
lines.speak_zh: 所以把芯片切成 4 乘 2 个布线格，每格宽 3、高 4。

lines.zh: 需求存成 demand[x][y]：先列，后行。
lines.en: Demand is stored as demand[x][y]: column first, then row.
lines.speak_zh: 需求按先列、后行的顺序存，写成 demand x y。
lines.speak_en: Demand is stored as demand x, y: column first, then row.

lines.zh: 每格能承受的布线量叫容量，这里是 2。
lines.en: What a tile can carry is its capacity; here it is 2.

lines.zh: 先看一个线网 ABCD：包围盒宽 7、高 4，HPWL = 11。
lines.en: Take one net, ABCD: its box is 7 wide and 4 tall, so HPWL = 11.
lines.speak_zh: 先看一个线网，A B C D。它的包围盒宽 7、高 4，半周长线长等于 11。
lines.speak_en: Take one net, A B C D. Its box is seven wide and four tall, so H P W L is eleven.

lines.en: The lower-left corner (1, 1) is in tile (0, 0); the upper-right (8, 5) is in tile (2, 1).
lines.speak_zh: 左下角 1、1，落在格子 0、0；右上角 8、5，落在格子 2、1。
lines.speak_en: The lower-left corner, one, one, is in tile zero, zero. The upper-right corner, eight, five, is in tile two, one.

lines.zh: 两角之间的格子全部选中：3 × 2 = 6 格。
lines.en: Every tile between the two corners is selected: 3 by 2, six tiles.
lines.speak_zh: 两角之间的格子全部选中：3 乘 2，一共 6 格。

lines.zh: RUDY 把 11 平均分给这 6 格：每格加 11/6。
lines.en: RUDY shares the 11 equally: each tile gets 11/6.
lines.speak_zh: 鲁迪把 11 平均分给这 6 格，每格加六分之十一。
lines.speak_en: Rudy shares the eleven equally: each tile gets eleven sixths.

lines.zh: 格子的下标先向下取整，再夹到网格里面。
lines.en: Tile indices are rounded down, then clamped into the grid.

lines.zh: 所以压在 x = 3 边线上的点，归右边一格。
lines.en: So a point exactly on x = 3 belongs to the tile on its right.
lines.speak_zh: 所以压在 x 等于 3 这条边线上的点，归右边那一格。
lines.speak_en: So a point exactly on x equals three belongs to the tile on its right.

lines.zh: 六个线网依次加进来：AB、CD、AC、BD、ABCD、EF。
lines.en: Add the six nets in turn: AB, CD, AC, BD, ABCD, EF.
lines.speak_zh: 六个线网依次加进来：A B，C D，A C，B D，A B C D，E F。
lines.speak_en: Add the six nets in turn: A B, C D, A C, B D, A B C D, and E F.

lines.zh: 最后一个加完之前，看到的只是部分累加。
lines.en: Until the last one is in, the map is only a partial sum.

lines.zh: 八格加起来是 34，正好等于 HPWL 总和。
lines.en: The eight tiles add up to 34, exactly the total HPWL.
lines.speak_zh: 八个格子加起来是 34，正好等于半周长线长的总和。
lines.speak_en: The eight tiles add up to thirty-four, exactly the total H P W L.

lines.zh: 和容量 2 比：需求 ÷ 容量是比值，超出的部分叫溢出。
lines.en: Against capacity 2: demand over capacity is the ratio, and the excess is overflow.
lines.speak_zh: 和容量 2 比：需求除以容量是比值，超出的部分叫溢出。

lines.zh: 六格溢出，总溢出 22，最挤的一格多出 14/3。
lines.en: Six tiles overflow: 22 in total, the worst one 14/3 over.
lines.speak_zh: 六个格子溢出，总溢出 22，最挤的一格多出三分之十四。
lines.speak_en: Six tiles overflow, twenty-two in total; the worst one is fourteen thirds over.

lines.zh: 把容量改成 1，需求一个数都不变，总溢出变成 28。
lines.en: Set capacity to 1: no demand changes, but total overflow becomes 28.

lines.zh: 写成代码，先检查输入：网格、容量、引脚都要合法。
lines.en: In code, validate first: the grid, the capacity and the pins must all be valid.

lines.zh: 然后对每个线网求盒子和两角所在的格，把 HPWL 平均加进中间每一格。
lines.en: Then for each net, find its box and its corner tiles, and add HPWL equally to every tile between.
lines.speak_zh: 然后对每个线网，求包围盒和两角所在的格子，把半周长线长平均加进中间的每一格。
lines.speak_en: Then for each net, find its box and its corner tiles, and add H P W L equally to every tile between.

lines.zh: 最后用容量读出比值和溢出；容量不会改变需求。
lines.en: Finally read ratio and overflow against capacity; capacity never changes demand.

lines.zh: 记住：一个线网，一个盒子，盒子里的格子平分它的线长。
lines.en: Remember: one net, one box, and the box's tiles share its length equally.

lines.zh: 需求守恒：图的总和等于 HPWL 总和；溢出要看容量。
lines.en: Demand is conserved: the map sums to total HPWL; overflow depends on capacity.
lines.speak_zh: 需求守恒：图的总和等于半周长线长的总和；溢出要看容量。
lines.speak_en: Demand is conserved: the map sums to the total H P W L, and overflow depends on capacity.

lines.zh: 进阶片讲按面积分的 RUDY，以及结论为什么会反过来。
lines.en: The advanced film covers area-weighted RUDY, and why conclusions can flip.
lines.speak_zh: 进阶片讲按面积分的鲁迪，以及结论为什么会反过来。
lines.speak_en: The advanced film covers area-weighted Rudy, and why conclusions can flip.
